column1: # GeneCompass base assets (upstream xCompass-AI/GeneCompass; staged under vendor/GeneCompass/, not in git),
# as on disk for the v2 build. md5 for every small file (prior_knowledge/, scdata/, GeneCompass_Base, and the
# randsel_500w_* state.json / dataset_info.json); md5 '-' = size only (the 329 arrow shards, 164 GB,
# not hashed on the login node). randsel_500w_mouse/state.json is the 2026-03-31 edit that drops the missing
# shard data-00107-of-00165.arrow (state.json.bak = the upstream original); scripts/stage_genecompass_assets.sh
# stages, edits and checks these files:  bash scripts/stage_genecompass_assets.sh --verify
